dependencies.title: bh-7: runtime files: JSON state, lock, config, logging
dependencies.description:
Repository: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration. Code, worktrees, sprint branches and PRs live there, on its `integrate/phase-bh`; atm-core's `integrate/phase-bh` holds only this plan.

## Goal
Everything the app shows lives in JSON files oversight can read (ANC-022), written safely by one process; settings and logging in one place each.

## Deliverables
1. `state.py`: folder `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/<root>/` (`<root>` = the phase root bead id; writes `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/.gitignore` containing `*` once): `lock`, `snapshot.json`, `state.json`, `merge.json`, `prs.json` written temp+rename with `to_json`, each exactly bh-1's detail-file type; `actions.jsonl` appended one `ActionLine` per line. Every writer returns `Result[None]` (`Err(IoFailed)` with the path and fix, never raises). `acquire_lock()` takes an OS advisory lock (`fcntl.flock`, non-blocking; macOS and Linux) on `lock`, held for the process's life and released by the OS when it dies, so a held lock always means a live holder: no stale-lock takeover exists. It returns `Ok` or `Err(LockHeld(snapshot_age_s))` (None when no snapshot exists); only the holder writes. Readers (`load_snapshot`, `load_state`, `load_prs`, `load_merges`) return `Result`; a missing file is `Err(NotFound)`.
2. `config.py` builds bh-1's `Config` from `.atm-bd/console.toml` `[console]` with `github = "graphql" | "rest" | "off"` (default graphql) and `interval` seconds (default 60, minimum 10); a missing file means all defaults; CLI flags `--github`, `--interval`, `--dry-run`, `--no-fetch` override it; returns `Result[Config]`, `Err(ConfigInvalid)` naming the key, the value and the allowed values (ANC-018).
3. `log.py`: one sc-observability logger per process under `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/logs/` (`create_logger(LoggerConfig(service="atm-bd-console", log_root=...))`); `event(action, **fields)` with actions `tick_start`, `tick_end`, `read` (source, duration_ms, ok), `github_read` (mode, ok), `action`, `hold`, `error`; times UTC; never writes to stdout or stderr.

## Does Not Close
- what goes in the files (bh-6); when they are written (bh-9).
dependencies.design:
## Files
Types are bh-1's detail-file table (frozen there); this sprint writes them and adds nothing. Written: snapshot.json and state.json every tick; merge.json on each merge check; prs.json on each GitHub read; actions.jsonl appended per line. merge.json and prs.json are the runner's caches between cycles.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] (D1) A second process gets `Err(LockHeld)` with the snapshot age (None with no snapshot); after the holder process is killed (SIGKILL) the next `acquire_lock` succeeds; a crash mid-write (temp left behind) leaves the previous snapshot.json readable.
- [ ] (D1) Every writer's file round-trips through `from_json` into its bh-1 type and equals the written instance; all times end in `Z`; two `actions.jsonl` appends give two parseable lines; `.gitignore` contains `*`.
- [ ] (D1) A write into a read-only folder returns `Err(IoFailed)` naming the path; a missing snapshot returns `Err(NotFound)`.
- [ ] (D2) No console.toml -> defaults graphql/60; file values apply; flags override the file; bad `github` value and interval 5 -> `Err(ConfigInvalid)` naming the key and allowed values.
- [ ] (D3) A test reads the log back with sc-observability `query` and finds each event kind; captured stdout and stderr are empty.

## Validation
- `cd apps/atm-bd-console && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check src tests`

dependencies.title: phase-bh: atm-bd-console: one tick for dispatch, escalation and the dispatch dashboard
dependencies.description:
## Goal
A small CLI, `atm-bd-console`, that runs one business-logic tick (build the phase snapshot, dispatch ready sanity and QA, report problems) and shows the dispatch dashboard. Reliability and clear logic are the goals. The same tick runs as the app (every 60 s) and as cron (`--once --headless`, every 10-15 min).

Why: on sc-lint 2026-10-14, 11 of 19 open tasks were on beads outside phase-k and bead-queues showed none of them; dispatch and oversight ran as separate tools with separate rules.

## Sprints (parallel-first)
| Sprint | Title | Wave | Depends on (consumes) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bh-1 | contract: Result, source and tick types, JSON codec | 1 | - |
| bh-2 | bead-queues as a front for `atm-bd-console show`, install check | 1 | - (calls the installed binary) |
| bh-3 | ATM source | 2 | bh-1 (types.py, result.py, fake_bin) |
| bh-4 | beads source and the atm-bd phase and formula mapping | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-5 | git and GitHub sources | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-6 | tick rules | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-7 | runtime files: JSON state, lock, config, logging | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-8 | renderers: dashboard, status bar, Status DAG, PRs | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-9 | runner and CLI (headless cron, show), MVP gates | 3 | bh-3..bh-8 (their modules) |
| bh-10 | Textual app (sole app.py owner) | 3 | bh-1 (StepFn, lock), bh-8 (renderers) |

Recipients: the lead from `--as`; the sanity and QA members from `.claude/project/atm-bd-orchestration.yaml` (Rand 2026-10-14), for the app and the cron alike. bh-10 owns app.py alone and runs beside bh-9 (Rand 2026-10-14).

Wave 2 sprints code against bh-1's types only and are developed in parallel, then rebased into the stack in layer order. Code lives in randlee/atm-bd-orchestration; the beads, plan file and phase file live in atm-core. Supersedes atm-bdo.3 and atm-bdo.4, and PR #129 (bead-dispatch).
dependencies.design:
## Decisions (Rand, 2026-10-14)
1. One module per source, each returning bh-1's plain types: `atm_source.py` (ATM), `beads_source.py` (generic bd), `atm_bd.py` (atm-bd phase and formula; the only atm-bd-specific file), `git_source.py`, `github_source.py`. Business logic lives once, pure, in `model.py` and `dispatch.py`; renderers and the CLI only call it (ANC-001, ANC-002).
2. One `tick`; the app, the cron and `snapshot` call it through `runner.step`. Same input, same dispatches, messages and state (ANC-003).
3. Holds: not in bd ready, branch not on origin, no worktree, merge conflict (git merge-tree). PR and CI state never hold (ANC-004, ANC-015).
4. Reads: open `bd list`/`bd ready` by phase label plus batched `bd show`, never `bd list --all` or a closed sweep (ANC-005); `atm members`/`atm task list --all`. GitHub: one open-PR call per 10-min cycle (GraphQL, or REST, or off), plus PRs tab open and `r` (ANC-006, ANC-018); failures never stop work (ANC-017).
5. `--as <phase lead>` is mandatory, no fallback (ANC-007).
6. Problems: each new one sent at once; unresolved ones resent as one batch 10 min after the cycle's first send, then every 10 min (ANC-010). Merge conflicts and missing PRs go to the assignee, a red stack top to the lead (ANC-016); agent status is shown, never messaged (ANC-021).
7. Root closed or 60 min with nothing ready or in progress stops ticking (ANC-011).
8. Everything shown is in JSON under `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/<root>/` (ANC-022); stored times UTC, shown times local 24 h (ANC-020).

## Branches
Code: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration `integrate/phase-bh` off main; sprint PRs form one stack on it; one final PR to main. Plan file and phase file: atm-core `integrate/phase-bh` off develop.

## Governing documents
No requirements document or ADR governs this phase; every sprint's `requirements` and `adrs` are deliberately `NONE`. The anchors in docs/plans/phase-bh/anchors.json (ANC-001..022) and atm-bd-orchestration SKILL.md are the authority.

## Error handling and logging (Rand, 2026-10-14)
- Every fallible function returns `Ok[T] | Err`; `Err.error` is a discriminated union of frozen dataclasses (one `kind` literal each). No `raise` in the package.
- Launch errors exit with a clear message. After the app starts it never exits on an error: each error is shown and the next tick runs (ANC-014).
- Logging: `sc-observability` (PyPI, >=1.5.0), one logger per process, under `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/logs/`; never to the dashboard or cron stdout.
- External binary: mmdflux >=2.6.1 for the Status tab; missing -> error plus text fallback.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
## Phase Gates
- bh-1..bh-10 merged to atm-bd-orchestration integrate/phase-bh, then one PR to main, CI green, merge commit.
- The MVP gates are owned by bh-9's acceptance criteria (live tick on two teams, PR #129 closed, atm-bdo.3/.4 closed).

## After the phase (Rand, 2026-10-14)
- Consider building and publishing an atm-bd-console wheel that bundles the mmdflux binary per platform; not in this phase's scope.

dependencies.description:
## Goal
A small CLI, `atm-bd-console`, that runs one business-logic tick (build the phase snapshot, dispatch ready sanity and QA, report problems) and shows the dispatch dashboard. Reliability and clear logic are the goals. The same tick runs as the app (every 60 s) and as cron (`--once --headless`, every 10-15 min).

Why: on sc-lint 2026-10-14, 11 of 19 open tasks were on beads outside phase-k and bead-queues showed none of them; dispatch and oversight ran as separate tools with separate rules.

## Sprints (parallel-first)
| Sprint | Title | Wave | Depends on (consumes) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bh-1 | contract: Result, source and tick types, JSON codec | 1 | - |
| bh-2 | bead-queues as a front for `atm-bd-console show`, install check | 1 | - (calls the installed binary) |
| bh-3 | ATM source | 2 | bh-1 (types.py, result.py, fake_bin) |
| bh-4 | beads source and the atm-bd phase and formula mapping | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-5 | git and GitHub sources | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-6 | tick rules | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-7 | runtime files: JSON state, lock, config, logging | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-8 | renderers: dashboard, status bar, Status DAG, PRs | 2 | bh-1 |
| bh-9 | runner and CLI (headless cron, show), MVP gates | 3 | bh-3..bh-8 (their modules) |
| bh-10 | Textual app (sole app.py owner) | 3 | bh-1 (StepFn, lock), bh-8 (renderers) |

Recipients: the lead from `--as`; the sanity and QA members from `.claude/project/atm-bd-orchestration.yaml` (Rand 2026-10-14), for the app and the cron alike. bh-10 owns app.py alone and runs beside bh-9 (Rand 2026-10-14).

Wave 2 sprints code against bh-1's types only and are developed in parallel, then rebased into the stack in layer order. Code lives in randlee/atm-bd-orchestration; the beads, plan file and phase file live in atm-core. Supersedes atm-bdo.3 and atm-bdo.4, and PR #129 (bead-dispatch).
dependencies.design:
## Decisions (Rand, 2026-10-14)
1. One module per source, each returning bh-1's plain types: `atm_source.py` (ATM), `beads_source.py` (generic bd), `atm_bd.py` (atm-bd phase and formula; the only atm-bd-specific file), `git_source.py`, `github_source.py`. Business logic lives once, pure, in `model.py` and `dispatch.py`; renderers and the CLI only call it (ANC-001, ANC-002).
2. One `tick`; the app, the cron and `snapshot` call it through `runner.step`. Same input, same dispatches, messages and state (ANC-003).
3. Holds: not in bd ready, branch not on origin, no worktree, merge conflict (git merge-tree). PR and CI state never hold (ANC-004, ANC-015).
4. Reads: open `bd list`/`bd ready` by phase label plus batched `bd show`, never `bd list --all` or a closed sweep (ANC-005); `atm members`/`atm task list --all`. GitHub: one open-PR call per 10-min cycle (GraphQL, or REST, or off), plus PRs tab open and `r` (ANC-006, ANC-018); failures never stop work (ANC-017).
5. `--as <phase lead>` is mandatory, no fallback (ANC-007).
6. Problems: each new one sent at once; unresolved ones resent as one batch 10 min after the cycle's first send, then every 10 min (ANC-010). Merge conflicts and missing PRs go to the assignee, a red stack top to the lead (ANC-016); agent status is shown, never messaged (ANC-021).
7. Root closed or 60 min with nothing ready or in progress stops ticking (ANC-011).
8. Everything shown is in JSON under `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/<root>/` (ANC-022); stored times UTC, shown times local 24 h (ANC-020).

## Branches
Code: randlee/atm-bd-orchestration `integrate/phase-bh` off main; sprint PRs form one stack on it; one final PR to main. Plan file and phase file: atm-core `integrate/phase-bh` off develop.

## Governing documents
No requirements document or ADR governs this phase; every sprint's `requirements` and `adrs` are deliberately `NONE`. The anchors in docs/plans/phase-bh/anchors.json (ANC-001..022) and atm-bd-orchestration SKILL.md are the authority.

## Error handling and logging (Rand, 2026-10-14)
- Every fallible function returns `Ok[T] | Err`; `Err.error` is a discriminated union of frozen dataclasses (one `kind` literal each). No `raise` in the package.
- Launch errors exit with a clear message. After the app starts it never exits on an error: each error is shown and the next tick runs (ANC-014).
- Logging: `sc-observability` (PyPI, >=1.5.0), one logger per process, under `.atm-bd/atm-bd-console/logs/`; never to the dashboard or cron stdout.
- External binary: mmdflux >=2.6.1 for the Status tab; missing -> error plus text fallback.
